subject: CIBO
objective: Reduce drawdown and gross losses while preserving all Trader entries and never breaching the frozen ceiling floor.

promotion_logic.strict_pareto_floor_gate: capital >= hard floor AND DD < frozen-floor DD AND total gross loss < frozen-floor gross loss AND ATTACK gross loss < frozen-floor ATTACK gross loss
promotion_logic.carrier_reporting: Always report capital, DD, total gross loss and ATTACK gross loss deltas versus b2000-3999-f25.
promotion_logic.headroom_usage: Capital may fall below the carrier only to buy material DD/gross-loss compression, but must never fall below the frozen floor.
promotion_logic.preferred_promotion: Promote non-dominated candidates; prefer simultaneous lower DD/loss with equal-or-higher capital.
